Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

Treat boundary lines as dividers, not automatic instructions to copy every region: identify the specific source object/pattern and the exact destinations changed in demos. For sparse colored diagonals that become a full repeating grid, test whether each diagonal encodes one residue of a periodic color sequence: index cells by `column - row` modulo the candidate period, read the marker colors at those residues, then verify the same mapping at multiple positions and across demos before filling. Check the diagonal direction and phase explicitly; do not infer a general rule from a coincidental overlap or merely replace apparent gaps.
3. When multiple rules fit, request a demo that distinguishes them, especially before the first guess or after a wrong submission. Choose what to disambiguate explicitly (e.g. copy source into adjacent panel vs all panels, reflect vs translate, or replicate across a divider vs only fill the displayed repeat). A demo's matching dimensions/colors alone is not sufficient; verify its exact transformation signature and which regions remain unchanged. Treat the demo as evidence about the transformation, not as a template for color substitution: derive the rule from aligned input/output cells, including background and all marker colors, and check whether the demonstrated relation actually applies to the test before constructing an output.
4. Before submitting, construct and validate the complete grid: row count, each row width, allowed colors, every changed cell, and unchanged regions. Submit only when the transformation is supported; use `finish` only after the instance is over.
